urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo - shayela manje
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa i-blue reliever inhaler. Uma kungekho ngcono emizuzwini eyi-10 — shayela ku-10177.
red_flags: Izindebe, izinzipho, noma ubuso buphenduka luhlaza noma bumpunga
Isifuba simunca phakathi kwezimbambo ngokuphefumula ngakunye
I-reliever inhaler ayisizi noma iphele ngaphansi kwamahora angu-4
Ukozela, ukudideka, noma ukukhathala ngenxa yomzamo wokuphefumula
Isifuba esithulile - ukuhefuza kuyama ngoba ukugeleza komoya kuphansi kakhulu ukwenza umsindo

what_is_it.heading: Ukuhlasela kwe-asthma ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukuhlasela kwesifuba somoya kulapho imigudu yomoya emaphashini iqina ngokuzumayo, ikhukhumale, futhi igcwale amafinyila - okwenza kube nzima ukukhipha nokukhipha umoya.
paragraphs: Iningi lokuhlaselwa yisifuba somoya kunesibangela - igciwane, intuthu, impova, uthuli, umoya obandayo, ukuvivinya umzimba, noma ukucindezeleka ngokomzwelo. Ukuqina kwemisipha yomzila womoya, ulwelwesi luyavuvukala, futhi amafinyila avala okusele kwendlela yokuphefumula.

I-reliever inhaler (ngokuvamile eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) iphumuza imisipha yomzila womoya phakathi nemizuzu. Uma kungasebenzi, noma uma ukuhlaselwa kuza kaningi, umuntu udinga usizo oluphuthumayo - ukuhlaselwa okunzima kungabulala.

items.headline: 1 ku10
items.body: Cishe ingane eyodwa kweziyi-10 yaseNingizimu Afrika inesifuba somoya. Abantu abadala abaningi banayo ngaphandle kokuqaphela.

items.headline: Usabulala
items.body: Amakhulu abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abulawa yisifuba somoya minyaka yonke - ukufa okuningi kuyagwemeka ngokwelashwa okufanele.

items.headline: Ama-inhalers amabili
items.body: I-reliever eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (esetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlaselwa) kanye ne-brown preventer (esetshenziswa nsuku zonke) - isivimbeli yiso esikugcina ungangeni enkingeni.

items.headline: Phila ngokugcwele
items.body: Isifuba somoya esilawulwa kahle akufanele sikuvimbele kwezemidlalo, isikole, umsebenzi, noma ukulala. Uma kunjalo - ukwelashwa kwakho kudinga ukulungiswa.

pull_quote.text: Uma ufinyelela i-inhaler yakho yokukhulula ngaphezu kokuphindwe kabili ngesonto, i-asthma yakho ayilawulwa kahle. Bonana nodokotela - ungagcini nje ngokugcwalisa okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.

signs.heading: Yeka ukuhlasela kubukeka
signs.lede: Ukuhlasela kwesifuba somoya kuvame ukukhula emahoreni amaningi, kwesinye isikhathi ngezinsuku. Uma welapha kusenesikhathi, kuba lula ukuyeka.

items.title: Ukuhefuzela
items.description: Umsindo wekhwela uma uphefumula, kwesinye isikhathi ungene. Isifuba esithulile lapho kuhlaselwa kakhulu sisho ukuthi ukugeleza komoya kwehle ngendlela eyingozi.

items.title: Ukuphelelwa umoya
items.description: Ukuzabalaza ukuthola umoya ogcwele. Awukwazi ukuqeda umusho ngaphandle kokumisa isikhashana. Isifuba sizizwa siqinile.

items.title: Ukukhwehlela okunganqamuki
items.description: Ukukhwehlela okomile, okungapheli, kuvame ukubi kakhulu ebusuku noma ekuseni kakhulu. Ngezinye izikhathi uphawu kuphela ezinganeni.

items.title: Ulimi lomzimba
items.description: Sizingele phambili, amahlombe aphakanyisiwe, izimbambo zidonsa umoya ngamunye, ukuphefumula ngokushesha, ukukhathala.

items.fact: Abanye bayakwenza, abaningi abakwenzi. Ngisho nalapho izimpawu seziphelile, ukuzwela kwendlela yokuphefumula kungabuya kunoma iyiphi iminyaka. Gcina i-inhaler yokuvimbela iqhubeka njengoba kuyalelwe.
Ama-steroid ahogelwe kusivimbeli esinsundu umthamo ophansi kakhulu futhi usebenza endaweni emaphashini. Ziphephe kakhulu kune-oral steroids edingekayo lapho ukuhlaselwa kuba kubi.

items.myth: Uma ukwazi ukukhuluma, ukuhlasela akubi kakhulu.
items.fact: Inkulumo enomkhawulo emishwaneni emifushane - noma amagama angawodwa - kuwuphawu oluyingozi. Isifuba esithule sibi kakhulu, asingcono.

items.myth: Umuthi wesifuba somoya udingeka kuphela uma uzwa izimpawu.
items.fact: Isivikeli (brown) inhaler kufanele sisetshenziswe nsuku zonke, ngisho nalapho uzizwa uphilile. Ilawula ukuvuvukala okuyisisekelo okubangela ukuhlaselwa.

items.title: Hlala uqonde. Khulula izingubo ezimpintshayo
items.description: Ungalali phansi. Ukuhlala uphakamise izingalo kwenza ukuphefumula kube lula. Hlala uzolile - ukwethuka kubhebhethekisa ukuphefumula.

items.title: Sebenzisa i-blue reliever inhaler - 1 puff
items.description: Sebenzisa i-spacer uma unaso. Linda imizuzwana engama-30 ukuya kwengama-60. Phinda ingqikithi yokukhukhumeza okungafika ku-10 emizuzwini eyi-10 yokuqala.

items.title: Uma kungekho ngcono emizuzwini eyi-10 — shayela ku-10177
items.description: Ithi 'ukuhlasela kwesifuba somoya okunzima'. Qhubeka nokusebenzisa okokukhulula njalo emizuzwini embalwa kuze kufike abezimo eziphuthumayo.

items.title: Uma ziwa noma ziba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka - shayela ngokushesha
items.description: Ungalindi imizuzu eyi-10. Ukuhlasela okunzima kungasongela ukuphila ngokushesha.

items.title: Ngemva kokuhlasela - bona udokotela
items.description: Konke ukuhlasela obekudinga okungaphezu komthamo ojwayelekile wokudambisa kuwuphawu uhlelo lwakho lwesifuba somoya ludinga ukulungiswa. Ungakweqi ukulandelela.

get_help.heading: Ubani okufanele ashayele
get_help.lede: Uma i-inhaler eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ingasebenzi noma ukuhlaselwa kuya kaningi, thola usizo. Isifuba somoya siyelapheka.

helplines.name: Isimo esiphuthumayo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifinyelela kunoma iyiphi isevisi yezimo eziphuthumayo ngomakhalekhukhwini

helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuhlolwa kwesifuba somoya kanye nama-inhalers
